task: Production frontend route and source audit
scope: Read-only route, component, client and endpoint contract audit before delegated fixes. New findings beyond prior38; no browser interaction by this agent.
limitations: Source-only functional findings require root integration/browser verification.
Hosted design tools not used; all ten local reference catalog summaries consulted. Existing green/navy brand kept; no new library selected.
Money, tenant/auth and provider readiness remain subject to isolated adversarial tests and qualified human review; runtime authentication/data sources not assumed safe from presence of APIs.

findings.title: Mechanic role cannot mount its dashboard
findings.trigger: Mechanic opens /mechanic or signs in to /dashboard: /mechanic is missing from MECHANIC_ROUTES, then dashboard default allowedRoles is partner only; role home equality prevents another redirect and leaves blank page.
findings.proposedFix: Allow mechanic only on the already authorized mechanic route subset; keep partner-only pages denied; make its home and mobile sign-out coherent.
findings.evidence: Source and caller/contract inspection; browser reproduction delegated to root.

findings.title: Real MFA setup errors are replaced with a fake secret and QR
findings.trigger: mfaSetup rejects with outage/401/config failure; catch fabricates setup and Continue becomes enabled.
findings.proposedFix: Show actual recoverable setup error; never fabricate issuer/authenticator state.
findings.evidence: Source and caller/contract inspection; browser reproduction delegated to root.

findings.title: Standalone MFA completion never updates mounted auth context
findings.trigger: Login returns mfaRequired leaving context loading; challenge writes storage but never setUser/refresh, and routes to fixed /dashboard for all roles.
findings.proposedFix: Adopt verified returned user in context and select correct role destination; preserve safe intended route.
findings.evidence: Source and caller/contract inspection; browser reproduction delegated to root.

findings.title: Saved MFA backup codes cannot be entered
findings.trigger: Saved backup codes contain letters and hyphens, but challenge only accepts six numeric digits.
findings.proposedFix: Provide explicit backup-code entry using existing server challenge contract; bound/validate input.
findings.evidence: Source and caller/contract inspection; browser reproduction delegated to root.

findings.title: Session-expired reauthentication ignores MFA and role
findings.trigger: Any role reauthenticates, or MFA account submits credentials: it announces welcome and pushes /customer regardless mfaRequired.
findings.proposedFix: Reuse normal credential/MFA result routing and do not announce full signin until verified.
findings.evidence: Source and caller/contract inspection; browser reproduction delegated to root.

findings.title: In-progress page ignores verified role without return URL and unsafe path guard
findings.trigger: Customer/company/admin opens in-progress without query: returnUrl default /dashboard wins role destination; startsWith accepts protocol-relative routes.
findings.proposedFix: Use one safe internal-return route helper and role destination fallback.
findings.evidence: Source and caller/contract inspection; browser reproduction delegated to root.

findings.title: Auth failure Retry does not retry authentication
findings.trigger: Retry sets unused local status, refreshes same client page, rendered AuthStatus remains literal failure.
findings.proposedFix: Navigate to a concrete retry flow with safe return destination.
findings.evidence: Source and caller/contract inspection; browser reproduction delegated to root.

findings.title: Success page omits mechanic destination and starts while session unresolved
findings.trigger: Mechanic success routes customer; loading/unauthenticated starts timer and shows dashboard link before role known.
findings.proposedFix: Wait for verified session and map every role; signed-out redirect to signin.
findings.evidence: Source and caller/contract inspection; browser reproduction delegated to root.

findings.title: Admin signin falsely announces authorization for non-admin credentials
findings.trigger: General login endpoint can return a non-admin user; page still says admin authorization granted before guard redirects.
findings.proposedFix: Inspect verified result role and show coherent role outcome without expanding server permissions.
findings.evidence: Source and caller/contract inspection; browser reproduction delegated to root.

findings.title: Failed background refresh replaces last good dashboard records
findings.trigger: Polling rejects while data exists: error set without clearing data, yet boundary branches on any error and hides records.
findings.proposedFix: Keep last good records with explicit nonblocking refresh warning, retry, and recover on success.
findings.evidence: Source and caller/contract inspection; browser reproduction delegated to root.

findings.title: Empty-state actions silently dropped by boundary
findings.trigger: Caller supplies empty.action (for example wallet add-funds); boundary only forwards title/message/icon.
findings.proposedFix: Forward action and regression-test contract.
findings.evidence: Source and caller/contract inspection; browser reproduction delegated to root.

findings.title: Funding confirmation rounds away kobo and uses binary money arithmetic
findings.trigger: Amount 100.25 with absorbed fee renders Pay 100; customer fee can be a rounded binary calculation and total rounds to whole naira.
findings.proposedFix: Parse exact minor units, calculate same provider quote formula with exact integers/decimal, format two decimals.
findings.evidence: Source and caller/contract inspection; browser reproduction delegated to root.

findings.title: Funding config failure claims zero customer fee
findings.trigger: Config request fails or is pending: fallback says fee absorbed and zero despite unknown actual bearer/fee.
findings.proposedFix: Show quote/config loading and recoverable failure; do not enable misleading price authorization.
findings.evidence: Source and caller/contract inspection; browser reproduction delegated to root.

findings.title: Push rejection has no catch or visible error
findings.trigger: Permission denied, PushManager or subscription API rejects; handleToggle only finally, leaving unhandled rejection without toast or inline explanation.
findings.proposedFix: Catch expected failures, restore truthful toggle and explain user recovery; guard transaction state.
findings.evidence: Source and caller/contract inspection; browser reproduction delegated to root.

findings.title: My Card load failures leave primary controls absent and do not expose retry
findings.trigger: Card/request Promise.all rejects: hasCard null so neither card nor request action appears; open-card request rejects without catch.
findings.proposedFix: Use explicit loading/error state with retry, cancellation guards, and independent useful data where safe.
findings.evidence: Source and caller/contract inspection; browser reproduction delegated to root.

findings.title: Card purchase refusal directs user to invented support number
findings.trigger: Unexposed 503 card checkout error says contact 0700 000 0000, absent verified support configuration.
findings.proposedFix: Use existing support route and remove fictional telephone.
findings.evidence: Source and caller/contract inspection; browser reproduction delegated to root.

findings.title: Wallet load failure shows zero balance and no-confirmed-payments as fact
findings.trigger: Wallet pending/fails before first load: balance defaults zero while only history has AsyncBoundary error.
findings.proposedFix: Show unavailable/loading for unknown funds; preserve stale known balance with timestamp/warning.
findings.evidence: Source and caller/contract inspection; browser reproduction delegated to root.

findings.title: Fuel code and order refresh does not recover visible load error
findings.trigger: Failed refresh sets error; successful refresh does not clear it and no visible load retry control.
findings.proposedFix: Clear only relevant resolved errors, expose reload, preserve distinct confirmation error until resolved.
findings.evidence: Source and caller/contract inspection; browser reproduction delegated to root.

findings.title: Receipt deep link reopens after every polling tick
findings.trigger: /customer/transaction-detail?id=X opens receipt; closing modal leaves id query and next history poll resets selectedTxn.
findings.proposedFix: Consume intended deep link once or clear query on close without resetting user selection.
findings.evidence: Source and caller/contract inspection; browser reproduction delegated to root.

findings.title: Team invitation cannot be accepted
findings.trigger: Invite email points signup?invite; no UI or API redeems invites anywhere in project.
findings.proposedFix: Implement isolated one-time expiry/email/organization-bound acceptance workflow with adversarial tests and qualified auth/tenant release review.
findings.evidence: Source and caller/contract inspection; browser reproduction delegated to root.

findings.title: Only newest 100 fleet vehicles and cards accessible
findings.trigger: Fleet exceeds 100: service hardcodes limit=100, discards total, tables have no pagination.
findings.proposedFix: Expose pagination/search using existing capped API and total; keep IDs and ownership unchanged.
findings.evidence: Source and caller/contract inspection; browser reproduction delegated to root.

findings.title: Company transactions have no path past first 100 records
findings.trigger: More than 100 matches: summary admits only first100, CSV includes all but user cannot inspect older rows in dashboard.
findings.proposedFix: Add page state/offset + accessible navigation with filter changes reset.
findings.evidence: Source and caller/contract inspection; browser reproduction delegated to root.

findings.title: Fleet fuel budget and usable POS code flow unavailable in web UI
findings.trigger: Company creates virtual card but has no wallet topup/member allocation UI and no card POS-code/PIN controls; no webcalls to available endpoints.
findings.proposedFix: Define company operator/driver funding and authorizing flow; connect existing contracts only after auth/money invariants pass; otherwise explicitly mark feature blocked.
findings.evidence: Source and caller/contract inspection; browser reproduction delegated to root.

findings.title: Company operational requests cannot be followed through to service completion
findings.trigger: Company support exposes ticket list only, no protected message fetch/reply contract; maintenance/roadside creation is present but admin dispatch/provider update workflow cannot be found.
findings.proposedFix: Complete scoped support conversation/status coordination, or accurately state external manual coordination and provide concrete follow-up.
findings.evidence: Source and caller/contract inspection; browser reproduction delegated to root.

findings.title: Landing header primary navigation disappears at tablet widths
findings.trigger: Viewport 768–1023: desktop nav hidden until lg, toggle and expandedmenu hidden at md.
findings.proposedFix: Align nav/menu breakpoints, named navigation, touch targets, Escape/close behavior.
findings.evidence: Source and caller/contract inspection; browser reproduction delegated to root.

findings.title: Career application dialog has no accessible dialog/focus handling
findings.trigger: Open role application: no role/name/aria-modal/focus containment/Escape; unlabeled X; background stays keyboard reachable.
findings.proposedFix: Reuse existing useDialogFocus/DialogFrame; label close and associate title; retain responsive scrolling.
findings.evidence: Source and caller/contract inspection; browser reproduction delegated to root.

findings.title: Late application success can contaminate next job application
findings.trigger: Submit then close/cancel before response; close clears role/draft, later sets submitted true; opening another role falsely shows application received for new role.
findings.proposedFix: Guard busy dismissal/submission with synchronous lock; capture submitted role/draft or sequence; reset per opening.
findings.evidence: Source and caller/contract inspection; browser reproduction delegated to root.

findings.title: Privacy request labels and submitting state missing
findings.trigger: AccountEmail/RequestType labels not connected; form can submit repeatedly while awaiting POST.
findings.proposedFix: Associate stable IDs, canonical select values, bounded duplicate UI submit guard, busy/error/status feedback.
findings.evidence: Source and caller/contract inspection; browser reproduction delegated to root.

findings.title: Contact category field lacks associated label
findings.trigger: Screenreader focus on contact-requestType select has no accessible label.
findings.proposedFix: Add htmlFor to existing label, avoid redesign.
findings.evidence: Source and caller/contract inspection; browser reproduction delegated to root.

findings.title: Public legal and product claims lack operational evidence
findings.trigger: Pages assert NDPA compliant/DPO reply7days, enterprise ready, organizational stationcounts while legal review/verified SLA/network evidence unavailable; customer plan services/rewards include operational features without demonstrated service fulfillment.
findings.proposedFix: Keep user-requested plan grouping; qualify unverified promises and obtain owner/legal/provider sign-off rather than inventing compliance or scope.
findings.evidence: Source and caller/contract inspection; browser reproduction delegated to root.

findings.title: Reduced motion preference not represented in global scrolling rules
findings.trigger: User requests reduced motion but document forces smooth scrolling; individual spin/pulse styles remain.
findings.proposedFix: Add scoped prefers-reduced-motion fallback for smooth scroll and relevant ornamental motion without changing brand.
findings.evidence: Source and caller/contract inspection; browser reproduction delegated to root.

Navigation/type/explicit local-fixture catalogs; live production client selected unless explicit local mock flag and no API URL. Mock folder existence does not prove runtime fake data.
Stale documentation describes frontend-only but API integration exists; document correction needed, does not change actual runtime behavior.
